findings.current: “Hah. What an amusing fellow. Do you think I brought it for you?”
findings.defect: The translation reverses the explicit negation: Jeok calls Taekyung unfunny, not amusing.
findings.rationale: 웃기지도 않은 means “not even funny,” continuing Jeok’s irritation rather than expressing amusement.
findings.replacement: “Hah. You’re not even funny. Did you think I brought it for you?”
findings.source: “허, 참. 웃기지도 않은 놈이로고. 노부가 네놈 주려고 가져온 줄 아느냐?”

findings.current: If I had still been the F-rank Hunter who had rented a home for my family in an expensive Safety Sector far beyond our means and thrown myself into raids without rest to pay my mother’s hospital bills, I would never have used some cheap trick involving sharks.
findings.defect: The draft adds the unsupported detail that the family home was rented.
findings.rationale: 집을 마련하고 says he obtained or secured a home; it does not specify whether he rented or purchased it.
findings.replacement: If I had still been the F-rank Hunter who had secured a home for my family in an expensive Safety Sector far beyond our means and thrown myself into raids without rest to pay my mother’s hospital bills, I would never have used some cheap trick involving sharks.
findings.source: 형편에도 맞지 않는 값비싼 안전 구역(Safety Sector)에 가족이 살 집을 마련하고, 어머니의 병원비를 대기 위해 쉴 틈 없이 레이드에 매달렸던 F급 헌터였다면 상어를 이용한 꼼수 따위는 부리지 않았을 거다.

findings.current: “I have a bad feeling about this. That’s what I intend to do.”
findings.defect: “A bad feeling” suggests a premonition of danger, while Taekyung means that his earlier shortcut still leaves him morally uneasy.
findings.rationale: 찝찝해서 describes lingering discomfort or misgivings here, directly motivating his decision to redo the training properly.
findings.replacement: “It still doesn’t sit right with me. So yes, that’s what I intend to do.”

findings.current: He had even sent me away for training, only for me to form a Shark Water-Ski Team and use a cheap trick.
findings.defect: The draft loses the comic specificity that Jeok had outsourced or entrusted Taekyung’s training to someone else.
findings.rationale: 위탁 교육 specifically evokes commissioned or outsourced instruction, sharpening the narrator’s joke about Jeok’s perspective.
findings.replacement: He had even outsourced my training, only for me to put together a Shark Water-Ski Team and use a cheap trick.
findings.source: 적천강의 입장에서는 기가 찼을 것이다. 수련하라고 위탁 교육까지 보낸 놈이 상어 수상스키단을 꾸려 꼼수를 썼으니.

findings.current: “Want me to turn it into a death mask?”
findings.defect: A “death mask” is a cast made from a dead person’s face, not a miserable or deathly facial expression.
findings.rationale: 죽을상 means a miserable, deathly-looking face and answers Taekyung’s claim that he naturally has a smiling face.
findings.replacement: “Want me to make it look ready to die?”

findings.current: The Murim of the world seethed like water in a boiling cauldron.
findings.defect: “The Murim of the world” is an unnatural calque.
findings.rationale: 천하 modifies the scope of Murim as a whole; “the entire Murim world” conveys that meaning naturally.
findings.replacement: The entire Murim world seethed like water in a cauldron.
findings.source: 천하 무림이 가마솥 안의 물처럼 들끓었다.

findings.current: “The Murim Alliance is the symbol of orthodox Murim. The problem is the forces of demonic, heterodox arts and the Outer Lands.”
findings.defect: “Forces of demonic, heterodox arts” is grammatically malformed and obscures that the speaker means the people or factions belonging to those traditions.
findings.rationale: 사마외도 refers contextually to the demonic and heterodox elements outside orthodox Murim, not to abstract arts possessing forces.
findings.replacement: “The Murim Alliance is the symbol of orthodox Murim. The problem is those who practice demonic and heterodox arts—and the Outer Lands.”
findings.source: “무림맹은 정파 무림의 상징일세. 문제는 사마외도와 새외야.”
